newsitem.title: TAIWAN: FORECAST-Taiwan March industry output-Reuters poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Taiwan March industry output-Reuters poll.

text.p: A Reuter poll of Taiwan economists projected on average 5.57 percent growth for Taiwan's industrial output in March.
The official figures are due to be released by the economics ministry at around 0230 GMT on April 22.
February's industrial output rose 0.55 percent year-on-year.
Economists said a hog foot-and-mouth disease outbreak on March 20 that brought an overall pork export ban should not have a major impact on March's industrial output.

"The impact should be very small because the food industry's output accounted for only 5.6 percent of the total industrial output, not to mention the pork output under the food category," said HSBC James Capel economist Stephen Wang.
Taiwan said on Thursday it has lifted the export ban on pork, but officials said exporters must obtain permits from importing countries in advance.
Grand Cathay Securities vice-president Terry Chen said sound export growth in the electronics sector should contribute to growth in March's industrial output.
